faq.title: Solopreneur AI workspace questions
faq.description: The useful questions concern continuity, client quality, business control, and which recurring work is worth saving.

items.question: Is Floatboat a CRM or business-management suite?
items.answer: No. Existing systems remain the records for customers, accounting, and projects. Floatboat is the working environment that connects files, instructions, agents, and deliverables around a specific assignment.

items.question: Can it run my business without me?
items.answer: No. It can prepare work, expose decisions, and repeat approved steps, but the owner remains responsible for priorities, promises, pricing, customer relationships, and external actions.

items.question: Can it use my proposal and delivery templates?
items.answer: Yes. Add the offer language, structure, pricing assumptions, brand voice, and review checklist that apply to the current client.

items.question: How do I keep one client's context separate from another?
items.answer: Use separate project workspaces and folders, narrow file access, apply clear naming, and review connector permissions before reusing any workflow.

items.question: Will it send proposals or invoices automatically?
items.answer: Keep external sending and financial commitments behind explicit owner approval. A prepared action is not the same as an approved action.

items.question: Which task should I automate first?
items.answer: Choose a frequent task with stable inputs and an output you already know how to judge, such as proposal preparation or a weekly client update.

items.question: Can a workflow change as the business changes?
items.answer: Yes. Saved methods should remain editable so new offers, tools, clients, and approval points can be reflected without starting from zero.
